text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the autumn Tenno Sho is here. Gold Ship's rival, Tosen Jordan, is set to participate as well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Today, we're going to make chestnuts stuffed with sea urchin—aka Surprise in a Shell! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Surprise! Though they look like ordinary chestnuts, the innards are totally different! ☆ You should try to surprise your opponent during a race too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's competitive spirit is strong as ever…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I have to wonder if she remembers she's going up against Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What're you lookin' at? Wanna have a chestnut knuckle sandwich?
choice_data_list: Jordan will be out there today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! That's today! I totally forgot today is the big one!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: By the way, on an unrelated note…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Is there a rule against pelting people with chestnuts during the race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I confiscate every single one of Gold Ship's chestnuts on the spot.
